mythical-sanctuary.title: Mythical Sanctuary
mythical-sanctuary.hook: Explore different islands on land and sea, unearth fossils, reconstruct, revive and take care of the creatures that once ruled this world.
mythical-sanctuary.description:
What is it about?

In ancient times, creatures from all mythologies gathered to seek refuge from a terrible catastrophe.

Although they didn't survive, now it's your turn to give them another chance of life.

You play as an archaeologist who arrives for his new day at work, completely disoriented, and your goal is to help them.

muse-within.title: Muse Within
muse-within.hook: Travel through dream worlds, solve puzzles to collect kiwis, and grow your courage with every fruit to overcome your fears.
muse-within.description:
What is it about?

Every day, she promises herself that she'll finally tell her mother the truth; but each time fear takes over and the words remain unspoken.

Each failed night, she enters a dream world where kiwis appear scattered across strange landscapes, and she must overcome dangers to collect them all.

breaking-hearts.title: Breaking Hearts
breaking-hearts.hook: Go to your dream wedding, overcome goofy aah obstacles, beat your neighbours in chaotic timed rhythm battles, and kiss your way into turning an entire town into fabulous divas!
breaking-hearts.description:
What is it about?

It's finally the big day! Zoey and Zack are ready to get married, but there's just one tiny problem: the entire town has decided that they absolutely, under no circumstances, want that.

Fortunately, these love birds have a secret weapon: The power of a bisexual couple! But with great power comes great responsibility... I think?
